01 Robot perception Simulation

Webots Neural Vision Robot

02 Vision & control Simulation

Pan/Tilt Camera Tracking Simulation

A two-axis camera tracking moving drone geometry in MuJoCo. Rendered camera frames feed day/night vision models, an object tracker, and a controller that moves both simulated joints.

Python / PyTorch / MuJoCo / C
